algebraic_finite_sum.definition: a*sum(q**k for k=0..n-1), q**0=1 including q=0
algebraic_finite_sum.domain: n>=1 integer, a and q real

negative_examples: q=1 gives 0/0 if formula with 1-q is used
q=0 causes later adjacent ratio 0/0 and cannot be treated as a conventional geometric progression
a1=0 makes all later adjacent ratios undefined
source_usage: editorial mathematical clarification, teacher review required

standard_geometric_sequence.domain: nonzero a1, nonzero q, positive-integer n under adjacent nonzero ratios
standard_geometric_sequence.q_zero_or_a1_zero: does not meet nonzero-ratio definition, despite algebraic series existence
